objective: One genuinely scarce discount window (Black Friday), one deliberately cheap day (11.11), and the year's highest-value winback list — all without teaching the base to wait for a code.
strategy:
Black Friday, Strong Monday.

Commercial job: One genuinely scarce discount window (Black Friday), one deliberately cheap day (11.11), and the year's highest-value winback list — all without teaching the base to wait for a code.

Newcomer: Black Friday Week Zero (“Our only 25% of the year. Four days. Then it's gone.”). Scarcity plus the year's best price on the entry product: a four-day window converts fence-sitters without bleeding the rest of the year.

Winback: High-Value Homecoming (“You've spent ₹{lifetime}. Here's a seat back, at 22% off.”). Clients with the deepest history respond to a personal, high-value restart, and a 3-month plan is the right unit for people who used to train often.

Renewal: Commitment Issues? Solved. (“Three months instead of one. 20% off.”). November is the month 1 Month members drift; moving them onto 3 Months now carries them through the December shutdown and January.

Renewal: 11% on 11.11 (“11% off. One day only. Every renewal.”). A small, single-day, high-volume discount clears the month's renewals before Black Friday, so Black Friday stays scarce.
notes:
Moment: Two dated windows and nothing else — 11.11 (one day, 11% off every renewal) and Black Friday Week Zero (Thu 25 – Sun 28 Nov, 25% off the entry product, 200 places).
Build: new clients 40 buyers = ₹3.8L; reactivation 35 × ₹11,468 = ₹4.0L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹1.7L; renewals ₹17.0L. First visits needed 112; CRM leads needed 140.

keyDates.name: Black Friday
keyDates.note: 25% off the entry product, 200 places, 25–28 Nov.

items.detail: Set up Black Friday Week Zero in Momence (25–28 Nov.): 1 Month Unlimited at 25% off (₹15,179) for new clients — 200 places only, with a live counter at the desk.
Set up High-Value Homecoming in Momence (1–30 Nov.): 3 Months Unlimited at 22% off (₹45,127) — a personal call from the studio manager and a written 12-week plan.
Set up Commitment Issues? Solved. in Momence (1–30 Nov.): 3 Months Unlimited at 20% off (₹46,284) — 2 freezes through December and priority booking for January.
Set up 11% on 11.11 in Momence (11 Nov, 00:00–23:59 only): 11% off any renewal — 1 Month (₹18,013), 3 Months (₹51,491) or 6 Months (₹1,01,206).
Brief the team on the 4 November offers, who each one is for, and the no-stacking rule; print the offer cards for the desk.
Launch Black Friday Week Zero to First-time clients.
Launch High-Value Homecoming to Lapsed clients with ≥₹75k lifetime spend.
Launch Commitment Issues? Solved. to 1 Month members renewing in November.
Launch 11% on 11.11 to All members renewing 1–30 Nov.
Run 11.11: a single-day push (WhatsApp, stories, desk) with the 11% code live only for 24 hours; publish the renewal tally at 9 pm.

Weekly check: Black Friday Week Zero: Places claimed vs 200; 72-hour conversion. | High-Value Homecoming: Calls made; 3M restarts. | Commitment Issues? Solved.: 1M → 3M upgrades. | 11% on 11.11: Renewals on 11 Nov; share of the month's renewals cleared early.
Mid-month review against ₹26.5L: by the 15th aim for about half of 150 renewals, 30 reactivations and 40 new buyers (130 first visits). Push the lists, not a deeper discount.
Run the month's moment: Black Friday Week Zero (Thu 25 – Sun 28 Nov) with the 200-place counter, then close the window hard at 23:59 on Sunday — no extensions.
Close November: tag every redemption by offer, record results, and brief December's offers.
